real_s1.explanation: The unit responds to a single road vehicle shown whole in side or three-quarter view with its wheels visible, as opposed to cropped, front-only or interior views of a vehicle.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to a single road vehicle shown whole in side or three-quarter view with its wheels visible, as opposed to cropped, front-only or interior views of a vehicle.
parsed.evidence: Only the framing prediction held (whole side/three-quarter view vs. close-up/front/interior, d +0.48, 96th percentile). Real-vs-toy (63rd), red/orange color (83rd) and occlusion (81st) were positive but not distinctive for this unit, and the occlusion and toy comparisons had very small groups (6 and 9 photos).
parsed.missing_data: More photos of toys, models and occluded vehicles, and photos of non-vehicle objects in a side-profile view, to tell whether the unit codes vehicle profile shape in particular or whole-object framing in general.

real_s2.explanation: The unit responds to a whole road vehicle seen from the side or in three-quarter view, with its body and wheels visible, as opposed to cropped close-ups, front-only views or interiors.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to a whole road vehicle seen from the side or in three-quarter view, with its body and wheels visible, as opposed to cropped close-ups, front-only views or interiors.
parsed.evidence: Only the whole-vehicle side-view prediction held (d +0.51, 97th percentile). The red/orange color preference (d +0.18, 75th percentile) and the real-versus-toy distinction (d +0.27, 63rd percentile) did not hold, so color and realism appear secondary or absent.
parsed.missing_data: More photos of toys or models and of crowded multi-vehicle scenes, since those had too few examples, plus color comparisons that hold viewpoint constant.

real_s3.explanation: The unit responds to a single road vehicle that dominates the photo, shown whole in side or three-quarter view with its body and wheels visible, rather than cropped front, interior or detail close-ups or scenes where people or other objects compete with it.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to a single road vehicle that dominates the photo, shown whole in side or three-quarter view with its body and wheels visible, rather than cropped front, interior or detail close-ups or scenes where people or other objects compete with it.
parsed.evidence: Predictions on framing (d +0.48, 96th percentile) and on the vehicle dominating the scene (d +0.86, 99th percentile) held, while preferences for red/orange bodies (75th) and real vehicles over toys or models (63rd, only 9 toy photos) did not, so color and realness are not supported as distinct drivers.
parsed.missing_data: More photos of toys, models and cakes shown whole in side view, and more photos of many small or distant vehicles, to separate the whole-vehicle-profile shape from real full-size vehicles.
